PRIMARY.name: normalizedComplexContrast400
PRIMARY.definition: Imean(x,y)=mean_time I_j; X_k=sum_j (I_j-Imean) exp(-i2 pi k0 j/N); C400 = 2 X_k / (N Imean)

PRIMARY.mask: validMask = isfinite(Imean) & Imean > 0.01*median(positive finite Imean); invalid pixels stored complex NaN, excluded from all statistics
